lessons.name: Choose the short u or long u word that matches the picture

contents.text: <instructions>Which word matches the picture?</instructions>
Vowels can be short or long. A long vowel says its name. A short vowel does not.

header.text: The letter u is a vowel. When u is followed by just consonants, u does not say its name. It makes a short u sound (/ŭ/).
When u is followed by a consonant and a silent e, u says its name. It makes a long u sound (/ū/).
When u is followed by another vowel, the two vowels can make a vowel team. In vowel teams that start with u, u says its name. It makes a long u sound. The other vowel is silent.
